summary: Byrna Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of substantially all assets of HERO Defense Systems, LLC. The aggregate purchase price is $1,250,000, comprising $625,000 in cash and $625,000 in restricted stock (capped at 104,000 shares priced by 60-day VWAP), plus a 3.5% royalty on net sales (minimum $250,000 in five annual installments, capped at $5,000,000). $125,000 of cash is held in escrow for 18 months. The board recommends the transaction. This accretive bolt-on expands Byrna’s less-lethal product line. Watch for shareholder dilution from the stock component and integration execution risk.
